name: aqg-audit-adjudication
description: Decide whether to accept, reject, or mark needs-user-decision for each existing audit, code review, or second opinion finding, and produce a validated adjudication table in any repository. Use only after findings exist to verify current evidence, merge overlaps or conflicts, and plan remediation. Do not use to run the review itself or replace evidence closeout.

sentence_patterns: I have a list of code review issues — verify and accept or reject each one
审计返回了一批问题，请逐条核对后做裁决
两轮审查有重复和冲突，请合并证据后生成裁决表

cli_contract.0: success — adjudication table parsed and shape valid
cli_contract.1: validation failed — malformed table shape, incomplete cells, invalid decisions, or an underspecified needs-user-decision row
cli_contract.2: usage error — argparse propagates exit 2 on bad args

owner_only_actions: Production / branch protection / Owner-admin actions remain separate authorization gates

cases.prompt: An audit returned 8 findings; verify the evidence and adjudicate each one before remediation
Code review returned 12 issues — decide which to accept, reject, or escalate to the user
Two reviews overlap and conflict — merge the root causes and produce an adjudication table
审查返回了 5 条问题，请核对当前证据后逐条裁决
Use /aqg-audit-adjudication to produce the decision table only; do not modify code
